_comment: Curated marketing availability that intentionally differs from the computed feed (oth-dashboard buildings_public.json). Every override MUST carry source, as_of, reason. The sync script FAILS if |published_sf - computed_sf| exceeds driftThresholdSf — re-confirm and re-date the override instead of letting it go stale. suppress:true publishes the building as leased regardless of computed vacancy (not currently marketed). Never add financial fields here.
